page.overview:
Who is Athion Zathuda?

Sorrowlord was a powerful fey prince in the service of Sammanar. As an NPC, Zathuda is played by Matthew Mercer.

Zathuda is seven feet tall, with very pale skin, elongated ears, and black brows extending into the edges of his thick wavy long black hair. His eyes are dark grey, with big black pupils. He has magical tattoo markings framing his face, and wore dark armor with a hollow in it. The shoulders of the armor were wider than those of the ordinary guards present and clearly denoted someone of higher status. The Fatestitcher described him as "incredibly darkly handsome." His eyes and cheekbones were similar to those of his daughter.

When Bells Hells saw him again in Ruidus, the Sorrowlord was still wearing his dark armor, and he had some unkempt facial hair. When he was defeated by the adventurers in the Shrine of Gilded Gifts he lost part of his right leg due to Laudna's Disintegrate spell.

After his body was used in Morrigan's Loom, he became a pale tapestry that showed his face, but with empty eye sockets, framed by some of his hair. In this form he was able to speak, and the more he does the more personality and volume his face gains, even moving slightly in the tapestry itself.
